newsitem.title: USA: Allmerica Financial Corp Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Allmerica Financial Corp Q3 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
1996 Q3 includes $1.6 million of net realized investment gains, a $2.4 million gain from a differential earnings tax adjustment.

1995 Q3 includes $9.3 million in net realized investment gains, a differential earnings tax charge of $6.4 million and a $4.7 million charge related to coversion from a mutual to a stock organization.
1996 nine month period includes $23.9 million in net realized investment gains, a gain of $3.1 million from from the sale of a mutual fund servicing business and a $8.3 million tax-related gain.

1995 nine month period includes $11.7 million in net realized investment gains, a $13.4 million gain from the sale of the mutual fund servicing business, a $7.7 million differential earnings tax charge and a $10.7 million charge related to the company's conversion.
